subject: Pilot credit request: audit window & runway extension for Cardinal Analytics VPC POC
messages:
From: Rachel Lim <rachel@cardinal-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Jones <mike_jones@cardinal-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot credit request for VPC POC — compliance gating

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Cardinal Analytics is excited to move forward with a Private VPC proof-of-concept, but our compliance team has one gating ask before we can start: a short audit window and extended sandbox runway to complete the internal review and pen test.

Specifically we need:
- 4-week isolated trial (VPC) with extra credits to run ingestion + model evals (~120k tokens total).
- Access to SOC 2 evidence or a short summary of scope that maps to data residency and logging controls.
- A network runbook or IP allowlist so our infra team can schedule the pen test without disrupting service.

Would Redwood be able to sponsor credits for the extended trial and provide the SOC2 summary? If so, we can finalize dates and sign any needed addendum. Our timeline is tight — we aim to kick off the trial week of 6/22.

Appreciate any guidance on the fastest path.

Thanks,
Rachel Lim
Head of Data Platform | Cardinal Analytics

Attachment: (none in this message)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lim <rachel@cardinal-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request for VPC POC — compliance gating

Hi Rachel — great to meet yesterday and excited to help get this moving.

Short answer: yes, we can sponsor an extended isolated trial and share a SOC 2 evidence summary. To be explicit on next steps, looping in Ben (security sales) and Karthik (solutions engineering) so they can confirm the audit window and the exact credit/top-up amount. Lauren is on copy for approval routing.

Proposed baseline:
- 30k USD equivalent in trial credits applied to an isolated VPC project (covers the 4-week runway you requested).
- SOC 2 summary (one-page) that maps to log collection, retention, and access controls — I will attach that once Ben confirms.
- We will provide an IP allowlist template and a short network runbook from Karthik.

Can you confirm the expected ingestion/test schedule (rough daily token or throughput expectations) so we can size credits more accurately? If you prefer, Karthik can run a quick call with your infra folks to capture port/IP needs.

If all good, I will route this for approval today and aim to have credits and documents to you by 6/16 so you can start the week of 6/22.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Karthik — quick security checklist from our side.

We can provide a SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a short control mapping showing where logs are retained and how access is managed. Two items to confirm with Cardinal before we finalize:
1) Scope: will Cardinal be ingesting PHI or regulated healthcare data during the POC? If so, we need to validate additional contractual language and possibly an isolated on-prem option.
2) Pen test window: we require an agreed maintenance window for any active scans (preferred: 2-hour window scheduled, with our NOC on call).

Assuming no PHI and an agreed scan window, approval for credits is straightforward. I suggest we apply the $30k credit Kimberly proposed plus an additional $5k buffer if their daily ingestion spikes — we can re-evaluate after week one.

Attachment: SOC2-summary-template.docx (stub)

Ben Carter
Head of Solutions Security | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Lim <rachel@cardinal-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Jones <mike_jones@cardinal-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit request for VPC POC — compliance gating

Thanks Kim and Ben — quick answers:

- No regulated PHI will be included in the POC; data set is anonymized logs and product telemetry.
- Pen test window: we can do the 2-hour window on Thursdays between 10:00–12:00 PT; our infra lead (Mike) will coordinate with your NOC.
- Ingestion estimate: initial ingest ~6k tokens/day for the first 3 days (indexing), then steady-state 12–15k tokens/day during model evals for the rest of the trial. Total expected ~90–110k tokens.

Attached is the SOC2-Summary.pdf (redacted) and our preliminary network diagram. If Redwood can confirm the $35k sponsor credit and send the IP allowlist template, we will sign the trial addendum and confirm kickoff for 6/22.

Thanks,
Rachel Lim
Head of Data Platform | Cardinal Analytics

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf; network-diagram.png

Hi Rachel — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOC2 summary. I reviewed your ingestion numbers and the network diagram; this should be straightforward. A couple of practical notes before we flip the switch:

- IP Allowlist: I attached a short template with the minimal egress IPs and ports we require for the VPC setup. Please paste your CIDR blocks and return it; we can schedule an IP swap if you need NAT.
- Credits: Approved internally for $35k promo credit tied to the deal_id DW-8472. The credit will be applied to the isolated VPC project; it includes a one-time buffer for burst testing. We will monitor usage and can top up in week 1 if needed.
- Runbook: I attached a one-page POC-network-runbook.md (stub) with the pen test maintenance window process. During the pen test window our NOC will reduce autoscale to a fixed capacity to avoid noisy failures.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Rachel — confirm CIDR/IPs using the attached IP allowlist template.
2) Kimberly — sign the trial addendum (DocuSign link) and confirm the credit allocation.
3) Schedule a 30-minute handoff call (prep: infra + security) for 6/21 to sync on the pen test and onboarding.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-network-runbook.md; IP-allowlist-template.csv
